title: Navigate in Editor, Fly, and Walk
summary: Move between orbit editing, free flight, and a player-scale walk preview.
outcome: You can return to the object you were editing after exploring the scene.

steps.title: Orbit, pan, and zoom
steps.text: In Editor mode, right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, and scroll to zoom. Shift plus right-drag also pans.

steps.title: Recover your view
steps.text: Select an object and use Frame selection in all views; use Frame all views when nothing is selected.

sections.title: Fly through the map

steps.title: Enter Fly
steps.text: Turn on Fly in the Camera header and click the camera to focus it.

steps.title: Move and return
steps.text: Use W/S forward and back, A/D sideways, Q/E down and up, right-drag to look, and Shift for faster movement. Press Esc to return to Editor orbit.

tips: If movement keys seem inactive, click the camera to restore focus.

sections.title: Walk at player scale

steps.title: Enter Walk
steps.text: Turn on Walk in the Camera header and click the camera. Use W/A/S/D to move, Space to jump, and right-drag to look.

steps.title: Pause or reset
steps.text: If focus leaves the camera, click it to resume. Press R or use Reset to return to the walk entry position; Esc exits Walk.

tips: Walk depends on available collision; read the Camera status if it pauses or asks for a reset.
